cropper.min.js and cropper.min.css are Cropper.js 1.7.0: dist/cropper.min.js and
dist/cropper.min.css from the cropperjs npm package, vendored unmodified
(ADR-00033). 1.7.0 is the registry's "latest-1" dist-tag; its "latest" tag is
2.3.1, a rewrite as web components with a different API, which this crop step
does not use. Checked with `npm view cropperjs dist-tags` on 2026-11-03.
